summary: The launch stopped before encoding because the consensus immutable-support assignment did not make the reliability-mask boolean ABI explicit and produced a shape-mismatched advanced-index assignment.
evidence: The failure occurred at the pre-encode reliable-support restoration assignment.
No video, manifest, or acceptance result was emitted.
The correction makes ResidualConsensus.reliable explicitly bool and uses np.logical_not for immutable support.
lessons: Image-mask ABI types must be explicit at module boundaries; relying on bitwise inversion is unsafe even when small-window tests happen to pass.
limitations: This attempt produced no quality result.
next_actions: Add a boolean-ABI regression assertion and rerun the unchanged quality contract in a new directory.
